categories.summary: This Discord chat segment from the #💬-discussion channel contains minimal technical discussion. The primary content is a product announcement from nativesatoshi (Selcuk) introducing Coopa v4.0, a zero-trust digital sanctuary application deployed on Sepolia testnet. The system implements client-side encryption before storing files and messages on Irys/Arweave, ensuring server-side data privacy. The announcement requests community members to stress-test the architecture and provide UX feedback. Two other brief messages include a question about bridging from Base to Solana (from pusikurac___) which went unanswered, and two scam warnings from l.iamwallace97 and mai_0976 about specific user IDs. No technical discussions, problem-solving sessions, or implementation details were shared beyond the basic architectural description of Coopa's encryption approach.
